intervention_policy: One declared intervention per scenario, paired with c00. CAD transforms affect all roles; missing/wrong IDs are explicit detector-output fault injection, not a claim about decoder error frequency.
radial_policy: Forward distorted coordinate q_d=q_u*(1+k*||q_u||^2), normalized by image half diagonal, centered at (size-1)/2. Invert numerically for whole-RGB bilinear remapping; fixed black border and unchanged screen search guide. Re-detect markers and rod evidence from the same distorted RGB. This is a synthetic image-domain stressor including resampling, not measured physical lens calibration.
inference_policy: Use unchanged zero-distortion camera policy and narrow rod policy; all five cameras must validate. No GT, old physical results, refitting from target pixels, post-hoc alignment, or challenge-specific threshold tuning.
evaluation_policy: Retain all 30 case/scenario and 60 case/scenario/method rows including unavailable/withheld/empty. Report camera reprojection and center errors, native length, boundary count/bijection, curve recovery/precision/p95 and guarded gap. Compare to newly inferred c00. No overall accuracy acceptance threshold or G1 claim.
integrity_policy: Freeze sources, inputs, methods, interventions and evaluation before inference. Verify every receipt before/after inference and exactly replay evaluation in post. GT is opened only after all 30 normal records complete.
development_scope: Same previously inspected three synthetic fixture objects; interventions frozen before this run. Not held-out objects, real photos, full-cloud repair, or independent method comparisons.
